scope: One paired C128 serving diagnostic, 512 requests,256 input/256 output tokens; same serving launch settings as baseline; separate warmup and measured prompt set. Not a performance admission campaign.

masked.scope: C128,256 input/256 output,512 requests; captures after warmup; traced durations are not benchmark timings
limitations: Tracing perturbs runtime and batching; do not replace uninstrumented baseline results.
GPU intervals include communication polling/waits; interval union is not SM utilization.
Kernel durations and host API spans may overlap; sums are not additive wall-time components.
No CPU sampling or context-switch collection; API gaps cannot alone identify Python or OS scheduling causes.
